svg.title: Historical v1 representation health
svg.desc: Six panels show context and target embedding mean standard deviation, the worse low-spread dimension count, the worse effective rank, and position and velocity probe R-squared. Every completed model seed appears as a labeled point, and failed fits are listed below their method. These are historical v1 checkpoint replays and v1 test records.
